consultants.name: ABN Overseas Education
consultants.summary: Pakistan-based education consultancy offering in-person and virtual counselling.
consultants.destinations: UK, USA, Australia, Canada, Germany, New Zealand, Malaysia and other destinations listed on its website.
consultants.services: Course and university selection, admission assessment, application and scholarship guidance, student visa guidance, and IELTS preparation.
consultants.office: Head office: Plaza 150 CCA, adjacent to KFC, Phase 5, DHA, Lahore. Other offices include Karachi, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Gujranwala, Multan, Hyderabad, Peshawar and Mardan.

consultants.name: FES Higher Education Consultants
consultants.summary: Overseas education consultancy with a branch network across Pakistan.
consultants.destinations: UK, Australia, USA, Canada, Ireland and Indonesia, among other destinations listed on its website.
consultants.services: Profile review, course and university selection, applications, English-test preparation, visa-document and interview guidance, and pre-departure planning.
consultants.office: Lahore contact office: Office 31/2, Upper Ground, Mall of Lahore, 172 Tufail Road, Cantt. Branches also listed in Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Peshawar, Gujranwala, Wah Cantonment, Attock, Abbottabad and Mardan.

consultants.name: Dignosco
consultants.summary: College counselling provider serving students, professionals and parents, with online and in-person consultations.
